libcamera: camera_manager: Non-fatal duplicate id detection

There are some hardware configurations which currently generate a
duplicate camera ID when the camera is on a shared but multiplexed bus.

At present this is somewhat difficult to adapt to ensure a consistent
and unique id.

While this case is undesired, it presently causes libcamera to hit a
Fatal asssertion on real world hardware which then causes pipewire to
close.

This behaviour is even less desirable, and we can easily continue to
operate libcamera without a potentially duplicate camera.

Reduce the Fatal log level to an Error allowing the code to continue
without constructing this duplicate camera.

Link: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/camera/libcamera/-/work_items/303
Reviewed-by: Barnabás Pőcze <barnabas.pocze@ideasonboard.com>
Signed-off-by: Kieran Bingham <kieran.bingham@ideasonboard.com>
Reviewed-by: Laurent Pinchart <laurent.pinchart@ideasonboard.com>
Signed-off-by: Kieran Bingham <kieran.bingham@ideasonboard.com>

test: pipeline: Add a duplicate camera construction test

Prepare a test pipeline handler which will allow us to construct
custom cameras.

Use this pipeline handler to specifically prepare an environment to be
able to construct multiple cameras with the same ID to ensure we do not
have any system regressions from this in the future.

Acked-by: Jacopo Mondi <jacopo.mondi@ideasonboard.com>
Signed-off-by: Kieran Bingham <kieran.bingham@ideasonboard.com>

ipa: libipa: Support old enum names

It is somewhat unfortunate that the parsing logic uses the enum names directly,
and does not have separate key -> value mapping like the rpi ipa has. Commit
974102049a41 ("libcamera: controls: Remove common enum prefix") has changed
some enum names, crucially some of those have been used in tuning files.

To make the the transition, add support for using the old names and warn
about the new names.

Signed-off-by: Barnabás Pőcze <barnabas.pocze@ideasonboard.com>
Reviewed-by: Kieran Bingham <kieran.bingham@ideasonboard.com>
Signed-off-by: Kieran Bingham <kieran.bingham@ideasonboard.com>

qcam: viewfinder_gl: Set awb GL uniform for debayer shaders

Since commit 569e3a41e9e4 ("softisp: Split AWB from Combined Matrix")
trying to use qcam's debayer shaders results in a black picture because
of the awb GL uniform note getting set, which gets interpreted as all
AWB gains being 0.0.

Fixes: 569e3a41e9e4 ("softisp: Split AWB from Combined Matrix")
Signed-off-by: Hans de Goede <johannes.goede@oss.qualcomm.com>
Reviewed-by: Kieran Bingham <kieran.bingham@ideasonboard.com>
